pages.title: Mana Engines
pages.text: Engines do magic on their own, so long as something feeds them. Connect them to a $(l)Mana Battery$() with conduits, or place them right beside one. Their tops glow while they have power to work.$(br2)Right-click an engine to see what it is doing.

pages.title: Verdant Engine
pages.text: Every five seconds it urges up to six plants within $(l)4 blocks$() to grow, as Verdant Growth would. It only spends mana (4 per pulse) when something actually grows.$(br2)Crops, saplings and flowers all answer it.

pages.title: Research Engine
pages.text: Feed it $(item)Dull Shards$(): right-click with them, or point a hopper into it. Every 30 seconds it studies $(l)4 shards$() with $(l)25 mana$() and records a point of Knowledge, up to 20.$(br2)Right-click with an empty hand to take what it has learned.
